entities.name: Battle of Aster Fall
entities.description: Final battle between Adam Carthalion and Ravidel around 4180 AR on the plains of Ephren.

entities.name: Adam Carthalion
entities.description: Dominarian leader who died in the battle.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Planeswalker who manipulated Adam and conspired to take over Dominaria.

entities.name: Gwendolyn Carthalion
entities.description: Adam's wife who died during the quest Ravidel tricked him into.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Adam's infant son marked with the sigil of the new moon.

entities.name: Ezer
entities.description: Adam's loyal spellsquire who took charge of Jared.

entities.name: Estark
entities.description: City whose Festival of the Arena Adam traveled to attend.

entities.name: Planar Barge
entities.description: Ravidel's barge damaged by Adam's Backdraft.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane Ravidel plotted to take over.

events.summary: Adam travels west with his army while Ravidel invades the Plains of Ephren a second time.
events.quote: Ravidel invaded the Plains of Ephren on his Planar Barge for the second time.

events.summary: Ravidel mortally wounds Adam with Syphon Soul; Adam entrusts his infant son to Ezer.
events.quote: he entrusted his infant son, Jared Carthalion , marked with the sigil of the new moon, to his loyal spellsquire, Ezer

events.summary: Adam casts Backdraft, damaging Ravidel's barge and obliterating himself.
events.quote: Adam’s final act of defiance was a powerful Backdraft spell

events.summary: Syphon Soul alters Jared, leaving him hairless with a crescent moon mark; Ezer calls him a freak.
events.quote: a crescent moon mark appeared on his cheek

relations.note: Syphon Soul left him mortally wounded
relations.quote: Mortally wounded by a devastating Syphon Soul spell cast by Ravidel
he entrusted his infant son, Jared Carthalion
